summary: Response too cryptic on cost figures; clarification needed.
detailed_context: Nick asked Jarvis to resoften an EV charger email and reframe costs around resale/rental value. Jarvis delivered a draft, but Nick flagged it as 'too cryptic' regarding cost figures. Nick is now clarifying which number matters—the 'bigger number' that 'doesn't appear on a quote.' This indicates the AI failed to clearly distinguish between cost figures or explain them in plain language. Nick is patient enough to guide the fix, but the output quality missed expectations. Jarvis should rewrite more clearly and explicitly separate which costs are quoted vs. projected impact.
